metadata.name: UpdateBranch
metadata.description: Use this API for updating Branch information like address and phone number.

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked Example: 1.3 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of sender Example:  10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source from where API Call is initiated. CoreCard have multiple value of source for internal system (CoreMoney, SelfService, IVR, MobileSelfService) For external system expected source will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller Id of source from where API is initiated. It is End User phone number. Example: 7204454214 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called Id of destination for which API is initiated. It is Corecard IVR number. Example: 7314145404 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ANI
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: DNS
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Flag to retrieve error message in specific language Example: 'en' for English Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: RequestDate
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM-DD-YYYYTHH:MM:SS Example:- 11-12-2021T13:05:10 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: InstitutionID
request_fields.description: Institution ID of product. Valid Values:0-9 Example : 1230 Allowable Values: 4

request_fields.name: BranchCode
request_fields.description: Code assigned to branch from where the card was issued. Valid Values:0-9, A-Z Example:C1006 Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: BranchID
request_fields.description: Branch ID Valid values: 0-9 Example: 1001 Allowable Values: 4

request_fields.name: BranchName
request_fields.description: Branch name Valid values:- A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example : Georgia Branch Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: BranchLocation
request_fields.description: Location of the branch. Valid values : A-Z, a-z Example: Houston Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: PostalCode
request_fields.description: Postal Code of Branch Valid Values:A-Z,a-z,0-9 Example: 30093 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: AddressLine1
request_fields.description: Address Line 1 of the Branch Valid values : A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: 15 Penang Street Point Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: AddressLine2
request_fields.description: Address Line 2 of the Branch Valid values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: 1 mecca way Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: City
request_fields.description: City of Branch Valid values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: Norcross Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: State
request_fields.description: State of Branch Valid values are A-Z, a-z Example: GA Please refer Appendix Section : State Codes(US) Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: Country
request_fields.description: Two Character Country Code Valid values :A-Z, a-z Example: US Refer Appendix section : Country Code Values Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: BankInfo
request_fields.description: Bank Information. Valid values : 1, 2 1 - Add Bank Information 2 - Use Branch Parent Bank Example: 1 Allowable Values: 1

request_fields.name: ContactPersonName
request_fields.description: Name of the contact person of the branch. Valid values : A-Z, a-z Example: Adam Wilson Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: OfficePhoneNumber
request_fields.description: Office phone number of the branch Valid values are 0-9 Example : 79747955668 Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: MobileNumber
request_fields.description: Mobile Phone Number of contact person of branch Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 9876543210 Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: FaxNumber
request_fields.description: FAX number of branch Valid values are 0-9 Example:9632581470 Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: EmailAddress
request_fields.description: E Mail Address of Branch Valid Values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 @ . Example: [email protected] Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: BankName
request_fields.description: Name of the bank Valid values are A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example : BANCFIRST , Bank of America Allowable Values: 200

request_fields.name: BankAccountOwner
request_fields.description: Bank Account Owner's name Valid values : A-Z, a-z Example: Daniel Ross Condition:It is mandatory when BankInfo=1 Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: AccountType
request_fields.description: Type of Bank account. Valid vales 0,1 or 2 0 - Checking 1 - Savings 2 - General Ledger Example: 1 Condition:It is mandatory when BankInfo=1 Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: ABANumber
request_fields.description: Destination Routing and Transit number of institutions. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 623852453 Condition:It is mandatory when BankInfo=1 Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: BankAccountNumber
request_fields.description: Bank Account Number Valid Values:0-9 Example: 1122345678 Condition:It is mandatory when BankInfo=1 Allowable Values: 30

request_fields.name: CustomerReceiptInformationText
request_fields.description: Customer Receipt of the branch. Valid values are A-Z, a-z, 0-9 ,HTML tag Example: Hi CustomerName This is Branch Receipt. Allowable Values: 8000

request_fields.name: ProductID
request_fields.description: ID of the Account's Product Valid Values:0-9 Example: 1739,1758 Allowable Values: 4

request_fields.name: PlasticCode
request_fields.description: Plastic Code Valid values:0-9 Example: 32 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: ServiceFee
request_fields.description: Fee that should be charged while card creation for plastic which is based on product setup. Valid values 0-9 Example: 55.69 Allowable Values: 8

request_fields.name: ServiceFeeLoad
request_fields.description: Service Load fee to be charged Valid values 0-9 Example: 23.36 Allowable Values: 8

request_fields.name: AdvanceCollectionACHPayroll
request_fields.description: Advance collection of salary from customers through ACH payroll. Valid Value:- 1-Yes, 0-No Example:- 1

request_fields.name: ImmediatePostACH
request_fields.description: Flag to indicate the posting of Future dated ACH Transaction will be done on the effective date. Valid Value:- 1-Not Allowed, 2-All Credits and 3-Credits-Payroll Example:- 1

response_fields.name: Message
response_fields.description: Returns Error Message in case of Error.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: Returns result of API processing. If any error is found then value will be 'false' else 'true'.

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Returns Error Code in case of Error.

response_fields.name: ResponseData
response_fields.description: This is group of below data elements.
